recentItems.title: Blanche defends Trump's comments on Supreme Court after it rejects new mail-in voting restrictions
recentItems.description:
President Trump called the Supreme Court's refusal to enforce stricter mail-in voting rules a "big loss" for Republicans and Americans on Tuesday, claiming it will lead to cheating. A Brookings Institute analysis found just four cases of mail voter fraud for every 10 million ballots cast in 2016, 2018, 2020 and 2022. CBS News' Aaron Navarro reports.
